title: GapR is a nucleoid-associated protein that stiffens and overtwists DNA to promote transcription and replication
authors: Xinjue Wei; Lucy M. Kwiatkowski; Ryo Kawamura; John F. Marko; Monica S. Guo
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子力学与计算分析研究细菌核仁相关蛋白GapR与DNA的结合模式及其对转录的调控，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，但非典型TF-DNA，且方法以实验为主、计算分析为辅，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: GapR is an α-proteobacterial nucleoid-associated protein reported to either directly regulate transcription of AT-rich DNA or to regulate transcription indirectly through sensing DNA topology and modulating topoisomerase activity. We use single-DNA micromechanics, biolayer interferometry (BLI), and computational analysis to study GapR transcriptional regulation. Micromechanics experiments show that GapR overtwists DNA and shortens its contour length. GapR binding also substantially increases DNA bending persistence length and twist stiffness, while promoting duplex DNA melting at higher forces. Nonequilibrium binding experiments show GapR-DNA complexes to be extremely stable, with essentially no dissociation on hour-long time scales. Strikingly, our BLI experiments show that GapR has high affinity for AT-rich DNA while our micromechanics show that GapR binding is enhanced by pre-twisting of DNA, validating GapR affinity for both forms. By analyzing published GapR binding data, we differentiate between AT-rich and overtwisted DNA binding, revealing that overtwisted DNA primarily determines GapR localization. Lastly, we show that these two binding modes exert opposite effects on transcription. AT-rich binding stimulates initiation, likely by promoting RNA polymerase progression, while overtwisted DNA binding represses transcription, possibly by stabilizing local overtwist at promoters. We propose that GapR binding promotes a conformation of DNA ideal for efficient replication and transcription progression. 3 Key points GapR is a DNA structuring protein that binds AT-rich and overtwisted, positively supercoiled DNA GapR binding stiffens DNA, limits plectoneme formation, and melts undertwisted DNA at higher force GapR binding modes exert opposing effects on transcription initiation while promoting elongation
abstract_zh: GapR是一种α-变形菌纲的类核相关蛋白，据报道其可直接调控富含AT的DNA的转录，或通过感知DNA拓扑结构并调节拓扑异构酶活性间接调控转录。我们利用单DNA微力学、生物层干涉法（BLI）和计算分析来研究GapR的转录调控。微力学实验表明，GapR使DNA过度扭转并缩短其轮廓长度。GapR结合还显著增加DNA弯曲持久长度和扭转刚度，同时在较高力下促进双链DNA熔解。非平衡结合实验显示，GapR-DNA复合物极其稳定，在小时级时间尺度上基本无解离。值得注意的是，我们的BLI实验表明GapR对富含AT的DNA具有高亲和力，而我们的微力学实验显示GapR结合因DNA预扭转而增强，验证了GapR对两种形式的亲和力。通过分析已发表的GapR结合数据，我们区分了富含AT和过度扭转DNA的结合，揭示过度扭转DNA主要决定GapR的定位。最后，我们展示这两种结合模式对转录产生相反效应。富含AT的结合刺激起始，可能通过促进RNA聚合酶进程，而过度扭转DNA的结合抑制转录，可能通过稳定启动子处的局部过度扭转。我们提出GapR结合促进一种有利于高效复制和转录进程的DNA构象。3个关键点 GapR是一种DNA结构化蛋白，结合富含AT和过度扭转的正超螺旋DNA GapR结合使DNA变硬，限制螺旋线形成，并在较高力下熔解欠扭转DNA GapR结合模式对转录起始产生相反效应，同时促进延伸
